title: every authenticated request pays 11 queries in 7 serial round trips before its handler: in-process getSession runs the jwt after-hook (two sys_jwks reads, a discarded signature), and me/* resolve the grants twice
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 (the control plane's console open: 13 s to the last API response on staging, 30 calls with duplicates) cannot meet its acceptance (a splash under 4 s, a call budget) from cloud. The os-dev on that card measured one full console open on a local control plane at framework `f7e836da1ed3` / objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`, with Chromium and CDP initiator stacks mapped through source maps, on SQLite and on Postgres behind a 50 ms round trip (report `6225536289` on cloud#2914; every call's table is in the Attribution section of PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2941). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: the 142 most recent open objectstack issues carry no card on the per-request session prelude, `sys_jwks` reads per request or grants resolved twice.

## Measured (framework `f7e836da1ed3`, Postgres at 50 ms RTT, queries counted per request)

**22 of the 30 calls of a cloud pricing open pay the same prelude before any handler runs:** 11 queries in 7 serial round trips, about 380 ms. This is the card's "every call at least 1 s" on staging.
- `runtime/config`, discovery and `auth/config` read nothing.
- The better-auth organisation endpoints read the session in 3.

What the prelude does: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:3210` (and cloud's in-process session read) calls `auth.api.getSession`, which runs these steps.
1. It reads the session row.
2. plugin-auth reads the internal fields back (`plugin-auth/src/internal-field-readback.ts:268`).
3. It reads the user row.
4. It resolves the custom-session authz grants (`core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:1220`, 5 reads) and `readDisabledCatalogNames` (`:934`).
5. It runs the jwt plugin's `/get-session` after-hook (`plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:3026-3036`): two `sys_jwks` reads, plus a signature whose `set-auth-jwt` header an in-process caller throws away.

`me/permissions` and `me/localization` resolve the grants a second time (17 and 18 queries).

## Done when

- **An in-process principal read does not run the JWT after-hook.**
- **The signing key is cached,** not read from `sys_jwks` on every request.
- **The session and user rows are one read** (or one round).
- **Grants are memoized per request,** so `me/*` resolves them once.
- **A test counts the queries** of one authenticated request's prelude.

`rest-server.ts` changed on objectstack `main` `e246f06119` since the pin (+49/−261); the other files are unchanged. Re-measure at `main` first.

Dedupe words: getSession per request jwks, session prelude round trips, authz grants twice, in-process getSession jwt after-hook.
